From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Invoicelyx proposal + NetSuite connector notes

Dylan/Marissa — thanks for the ping. A few initial finance notes after skimming the quote:

1) Licensing model: the quote's line item labels are ambiguous. We need a clear definition: subscription (platform) vs connector (integration) vs seats (if applicable). Please get Jordan to label per-unit metrics (per-month, per-invoice, per-seat).

2) Capital vs operating: the migration services will be invoiced as professional services. We'll treat the SaaS subscription as OPEX. Finance prefers milestone-based invoicing for services > $50k.

3) NetSuite integration: we require that any vendor connector supports secure token auth and does not store raw card data in their system. Also, we need a mapping doc and sample payloads for our legal/security review.

4) Contract terms: we usually push for a 60-day opt-out in year 1 with a pro-rated refund clause on pre-paid amounts. If they insist on strict annual prepayment we should seek a better discount or escrow of funds.

Next steps: Marissa, procurement can ask for a redlineable SOW and milestone schedule. Jordan — can you send the technical integration spec and a SOC2 cert link?

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@invoicelyx.com>

Subject: Re: FW: Invoicelyx proposal + NetSuite connector notes

Hi Laura/Marissa/Dylan — thanks for the clear questions. Answers below and attached an updated SOW (SOW-billing-migration.docx).

- Licensing: connector is licensed per-organization (flat annual fee) — not per-seat. Platform pricing is usage-tiered (monthly invoice count). I've updated the quote to show unit metrics.
- Connector capabilities: it supports SuiteScript v2.1 and maps to custom fields. We include a field-mapping template (section 2 of the SOW).
- Security & data handling: Invoicelyx does not retain raw cardholder data. We tokenize at capture and send only tokens to our system. SOC2 Type II report is available; link: https://invoicelyx.com/soc2/report (password: supplied in SSO portal).
- Migration approach: milestone plan added — pilot (2 weeks), bulk sync (3-4 weeks), reconciliation window (2 weeks). 50% of PS fees invoiced on pilot acceptance, 40% on full sync, 10% on closeout.

Attachments: SOW-billing-migration.docx, Invoicelyx_Quote_v2.pdf

Jordan Patel
Enterprise Sales
Invoicelyx
